notes.title: Release Date
notes.content:
Hi there,

We have to postpone the Early Access release. I decided not to publish the game at it's current stage of development. We've made significant progress, but it's still not 100% playable. Nobody wants to play a tech demo these days, and that's why it's not going to be released until being enjoyable to play. 

We strive to deliver a better quality product than the two previous games. I hope you understand. The new release date is currently unknown. It depends on several factors. 

Thank you for your interest in our new title. 
Stay tuned!
